description:
The view event was recorded for the item list identified as **list‑123**, titled **“Summer Collection.”** This list was presented to the user through the **Online Store** affiliate and is associated with location **store‑45**.

The first product displayed was the **Leather Sandals** (SKU‑001) from the brand **SunStep**, classified under the primary category **Footwear** and the secondary category **Sandals**. No additional category levels (3‑5) were specified. The sandals were offered in the **Brown/42** variant at a price of **$79.99 USD** each, with a quantity of **1**. A discount of **$10.00** was applied, and the shopper used the coupon code **SUMMER10**. This item appears at index 0 in the list and inherits the same list ID (**list‑123**) and list name (**Summer Collection**).

The second product shown was a **Canvas Tote Bag** (SKU‑002) from **EcoCarry**, categorized as **Accessories**. It was priced at **$25.50 USD** per unit, with a quantity of **2**, and no discount was applied. No coupon was used for this item. It occupies index 1 in the list and, like the first item, is linked to list ID **list‑123**, list name **Summer Collection**, the **Online Store** affiliation, and location **store‑45**.
